performance.startup_scope: Agent construction: catalog ID validation and mode-specific index/cache loading; sentence-transformer model loading remains lazy until the first dense query
performance.latency_scope: wall-clock time inside Agent.respond, including first-query model loading
performance.memory_method: peak resident set size for the evaluator process

finalist_configuration.rationale: Iteration 01 keeps the selected Browsing-only clarification gates while evaluating memory-backed BM25 rotation after explicit negative feedback.
